completeness.why: All five sites call the existing getScheduledAmount; the template site passes the explicit 'sum-first' rounding variation but still selects it with its own op === 'isbetween' dispatch, a condition the shared function's value-type dispatch already covers, so it is scored partial (lower level when in between).

interface.why: Reuses the existing exported helper, widens it to accept null and adds a named rounding parameter that makes the template's halve-the-rounded-sum inconsistency explicit; the positional boolean 'inverse' before it forces callers to write a bare false.

disguised_duplication.where: The inlined ternaries at all sites are removed; the two rounding formulas sit side by side in getScheduledAmount as an explicit variation.
